suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam devnet-8 launch date decision (pending repricing analysis)
suggestions.rationale: Explicitly deferred from ACDT #89 for revisit at this call. Repricing analysis started July 25; final numbers expected this week. Launch tentatively early August but dependent on these numbers.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8070 Engine API implementation status and concerns
suggestions.rationale: Action item from ACDT #89 to raise implementation concerns promptly and revisit at next ACDT. GetBlobsV3/V4 and FCU custody_columns field are mandatory for devnet-8; all major clients confirmed but implementation alignment needs verification.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam devnet-7 status and builder bid selection issues
suggestions.rationale: Geth and Nethermind builders not winning bids on devnet-7; Teku favoring local blocks ~90% of the time. CL teams assigned to review bid-selection logic and add logging for accepted/rejected bids and circuit breaker activation.

suggestions.topic: Devnet-8 spec release and readiness (EL specs 7.x, CL alpha.13)
suggestions.rationale: Action item to merge EIP-2780 and EIP-8037 into EL specs and include in devnet-8 release. CL alpha.13 targeted for end of week per ACDT #89. Need confirmation both spec releases are ready before finalizing launch date.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam devnet-7 chaos testing results and learnings
suggestions.rationale: Devnet-7 held up over weekend per ACDT #89; ramping up load/chaos scenarios including Death Star and malicious Prysm node. Stable containers showing 10-20% performance degradation requiring optimization before testnet. Status update needed.
Mentioned in ACDT #88 as targeting within ~1 month for non-finality chaos testing. With devnet-8 launch imminent, worth discussing timeline and scope for devnet-9.

suggestions.topic: EIP-7997 BAL factory fork-boundary behavior resolution
suggestions.rationale: Decision made in ACDT #89 to close both open PRs; spec is correct (no BAL read at fork boundary). However, noted that Geth uniquely reads/deploys contract at fork boundary, creating divergence on chains without pre-deployed factory. Confirm this is fully resolved or needs documentation.
